Header presets per site type
purpose: Nine named presets (item + components) so a site type gets a sensible header in one flag: python sc_header.py apply SRC OUT --preset local-business. Each preset's combination is built and browser-tested against both fixtures.

name: Header probe (header_probe.py)
purpose: Renders a page in a real browser (Edge/Chrome via Playwright, file:// only) at 360/860/861/1280 and measures tap size, font size, contrast, sticky, menu open/close, Escape, focus, anchors, no-JS, reduced motion, console and network.

name: Header test runner (run_tests.py)
purpose: Builds the two engine fixtures offline in a temp copy, applies every item, runs lint + engine check + probe + a combo pass, writes TEST_RESULT.json, README.md and the catalog.

name: Header apply tool (sc_header.py)
purpose: Applies a header variant and components to a built page: swaps the header, injects one style and one script, lists items, regenerates the catalog, verifies manifests.

Byline and updated bar
purpose: A single-line bar under the headline with the author link, published date, updated date and reading time. Wraps to one item per line on phones.

name: Checklist block
purpose: A tick-off list built from real checkboxes, with a live count, a progress bar, a clear-all button and an optional saved state in the visitor's own browser.

name: Comparison table
purpose: A real data table for comparing options side by side. On narrow screens it scrolls sideways inside its own box with the row labels pinned on the left; the page itself never scrolls sideways.

name: Definition box
purpose: A boxed definition: the term in a dfn element, an optional word type and pronunciation, a plain-language definition and an optional example.

name: Developing story strip
purpose: A one-line strip above or below the headline that marks a story as developing, updated or corrected, with a time and an optional jump link. Three variants with a visible label word.

name: Glossary list with filter
purpose: An A to Z list of terms and definitions on a definition list, with a type-to-filter box that matches terms and definitions as the reader types.

name: Hero hook
purpose: An opening block for a page or article: small label, headline, one or two sentences that say what the page delivers, a meta line and up to two links. Light, dark and centered variants, no image.

name: Key facts box
purpose: An at-a-glance box of label and value pairs near the top of an article, built on a definition list. Stacked on phones, two columns from 640px up.

name: FAQ accordion
purpose: A list of questions that open on tap, built on native details and summary. Optional Open all button, one-at-a-time mode, opening by #hash and matching FAQPage JSON-LD.

name: Local resources (who to call)
purpose: A box that lists who to call for what: service name, a line on what it is for, hours, and a large tap-to-call link. Rows on wide screens, stacked on phones.

name: News lede block
purpose: The opening of a news story: dateline with place and date, a bold first sentence that carries the whole story, and a short why-it-matters line.

name: Pros and cons
purpose: Two lists, pros and cons, side by side from 640px and stacked on phones, each with a visible heading and a plus or minus mark, plus an optional one-line verdict.

name: Quick answer box
purpose: A question as a heading, a one or two sentence answer right under it, and a link down to the full explanation. Meant for pages that answer one question.

name: Sources list
purpose: A numbered list of sources at the end of an article, each with a name, publisher, date read and a link back to the sentence that cites it; plus the small numbered reference links used in the text.

name: Stat strip
purpose: A row of three or four large numbers with a unit and a one-line label under each. Two columns on phones, one row from 640px up. Light and dark variants.

name: Steps (how-to)
purpose: A numbered how-to list: big step numbers joined by a line, a title and one or two sentences per step, and an optional time and tools box above it.

name: Tabs block
purpose: Tabs that switch between panels of content, following the ARIA tabs pattern: arrow keys, Home and End, a roving tab stop and a focusable panel. Final state is in the markup, with a noscript fallback that shows every panel.

name: Timeline
purpose: A vertical timeline of dated events: a line down the left with a dot per event, then the date, a title and a short description. One column at every width.

name: TL;DR summary box
purpose: A short summary box near the top of a long article: an In short label and two to four bullets the reader can act on without reading further.

Age or notice gate
purpose: A blocking dialog that opens on load until the visitor confirms or leaves. It is a self-declaration notice, not age verification.

name: Back-to-top button
purpose: A fixed button that appears after scrolling and returns to the top of the page, moving keyboard focus to the main content. Scrolls instantly when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

name: Breaking news bar
purpose: A red full-width bar for one current story: a written label, headline, link and update time. Sits in the page flow, can be dismissed for the session, and hides itself after an expiry time so stale news does not stay up.

name: Collapsible callout
purpose: A callout built on the native details and summary elements: opens and closes with mouse, touch, Enter and Space, with no JavaScript.

name: Danger callout
purpose: A red callout for actions that cannot be undone or that put data or money at risk, in two variants: danger and critical.

name: Tip callout
purpose: A positive callout for tips and recommended practice, in two variants: tip and best practice.

name: Warning callout
purpose: An amber callout for things that can go wrong but do not destroy data, in two variants: warning and caution.

name: Countdown banner
purpose: An in-flow bar that counts down to a date and time you set, with days, hours, minutes and seconds, and swaps to an end message (or hides) when the time passes. The timer is silent for screen readers.

name: Call-to-action block
purpose: A boxed call to action with a heading, a short text, a primary button and a secondary link. Light and dark variants; the demo links point at anchors on the same page.

name: Definition / glossary callout
purpose: A box that defines a term in place, using a proper definition list with the term in a dfn element.

name: Editor's note
purpose: A restrained note from the editors placed at the top or bottom of a story, for context, standards or a content warning.

name: Emergency and weather alert banner
purpose: A full-width alert for severe weather or local emergencies in three severities (advisory, warning, emergency). Text must come from the issuing agency; the banner shows the label, issue time and a link to the official source.

name: Exit-intent popup
purpose: A modal that opens once per browser session when a mouse pointer leaves the window through the top edge. Never fires on touch devices.

name: FAQ accordion callout
purpose: A group of question-and-answer rows built on native details elements. The shared name attribute makes opening one close the others in current browsers.

name: Feedback slide-in
purpose: A Feedback button fixed at the bottom-left that opens a small non-modal panel with a 1 to 5 rating, an optional comment and a send button. The form posts to the URL you set.

name: Floating contact button
purpose: A 56px pill button fixed to the bottom-right corner that opens a small panel of contact links (email, phone, contact page). The label is text, not an icon image.

name: Inline update notice
purpose: A labelled notice for updates, corrections and clarifications inside an article, with a machine-readable date. Three variants.

name: Key takeaways box
purpose: A short summary box at the top of an article: a heading and a bulleted list of the main points.

name: Pro / con callout
purpose: Two side-by-side lists, Pros and Cons, that stack on narrow screens. Each list has a visible heading, so colour is never the only signal.

name: Promo ribbon
purpose: A text label flag on the corner of a card or box (Sale, New, Featured). Pure CSS; the label is real text, not an image.

name: Pull quote
purpose: A large quotation set apart from the article text, as a figure with a blockquote and a caption. Three layouts: bar, centered, and a floated aside on wide screens.

name: Push-notification soft ask
purpose: A friendly question shown before the browser's own permission prompt. The browser prompt only appears after the visitor clicks Yes; Not now is remembered for 30 days. It fires an sc:push-ask event and does nothing else.

name: Quote card
purpose: A framed quotation with attribution: a figure with a blockquote and a figcaption naming the speaker and source.

name: Share prompt
purpose: A small card that offers Share (where the browser supports it) and Copy link after the visitor has read most of the page. Once per session, never takes focus, and reports the result in a polite live region.

name: Slide-in notice
purpose: A small non-modal card that slides in at the bottom-right after a delay or scroll depth, once per session. It never takes focus and does not block the page; Escape or the close button dismisses it.

name: Sponsored / affiliate disclosure
purpose: A clearly labelled disclosure box for affiliate links and paid or sponsored content. Two variants; the text is placed before the content it applies to.

name: Stat callout
purpose: A box that puts two to four big figures side by side with a plain label under each and a source line. Stacks to one column on narrow screens.

name: Step callout
purpose: A numbered how-to box built on a real ordered list, with large numbered markers drawn by CSS counters.

name: Timed or scroll-triggered popup
purpose: A modal that opens once per session after a delay or a scroll depth. It waits while the visitor is typing in a field or another dialog is open.

name: Toast notifications
purpose: Short status messages that stack in a polite live region at the bottom of the window. Auto-dismiss pauses on hover and focus, every toast can be dismissed, and an action button is optional.

name: Tooltip
purpose: A short text bubble on a button, shown on hover and on keyboard focus. Escape dismisses it, the pointer can move onto the bubble without it closing, and it stays inside the window.

name: Welcome-back bar
purpose: A thin in-flow bar that greets returning visitors with the date of their last visit. It stays hidden on the first visit. Uses localStorage only, no cookies and no network.

name: Ad slot
purpose: Labelled box with fixed height for an ad unit. Reserves the space before the ad loads so the page does not shift. Hides itself while empty. The caller supplies the ad code.

name: Archive list by month
purpose: Monthly archive links with post counts.

name: Author box
purpose: Author name, short bio and a profile link. Shows a photo only when the caller supplies an owned image address.

name: Back to top button
purpose: Fixed button that appears after the visitor scrolls 400 px and jumps to the top of the page.

name: Category list
purpose: Category links with optional post counts. The current category is marked.

name: Contact card

name: Call to action box
purpose: Heading, one sentence and one button link.

name: Event list

name: FAQ accordion

name: Jump to section

name: Link list
